edge_sample.source_text: definition Caratheodory: For any measure $\mu$ on a local $X$, the caratheodory extension is: \[\mu(A) = \inf \{\mu(U) | A \subset U \in O(X)\},~A\in X\]
edge_sample.target_text: lemma Caratheodory Extensions are monotonic: The caratheodory extension is monotonic i.e. \[A \le B \implies \mu(A) \le \mu(B)\]

edge_sample.source_text: definition Open sublocal: For any $U \in O(E)$, the sublocal $[U]$ is called an open sublocal of $E$.
edge_sample.target_text: definition Complement: The complement of an open sublocal $U$ of $X$ is the sublocal $X \setminus U$. (Leroy p. 12)
